vocabulary.example: She made a sacrifice for her family.
The town is famous for its cheese.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a drawing of an area showing roads, towns etc.
one movement of your foot; one stage of a process
vocabulary.example: Follow the steps in the guide.
Living near work is a big advantage.

vocabulary.meaning_en: something funny you say or do

fine_lines.title: There's nothing to it vs one step at a time
fine_lines.explanation_ar: there's nothing to it تعني أن العمل سهل جداً. one step at a time تعني أن تفعل الشيء ببطء وخطوة بخطوة، غالباً لأنه صعب أو جديد.
fine_lines.explanation_en: 'There's nothing to it' = it's very easy. 'One step at a time' = do it slowly, stage by stage, often because it is hard or new.

examples.sentence: Making tea? There's nothing to it.
Learning a language is hard - take it one step at a time.

fine_lines.title: Take one for the team vs the joke is on you
fine_lines.explanation_ar: take one for the team أن تقبل شيئاً غير مريح من أجل مصلحة المجموعة. the joke is on you أن الشخص الذي سخر من غيره صار هو المضحوك عليه.
fine_lines.explanation_en: 'Take one for the team' = accept something unpleasant to help the group. 'The joke is on you' = the person who laughed at others now looks silly.

examples.sentence: I'll take one for the team and work on Saturday.
You laughed at my old phone, but yours is broken - the joke's on you!

expressions.meaning_en: to do something unpleasant so the group can benefit
expressions.example: There weren't enough seats, so I took one for the team and stood.

expressions.meaning_en: to make a person or place famous or well known
expressions.example: That festival put our small town on the map.

expressions.meaning_en: slowly and carefully, doing one part before the next
expressions.example: Don't rush the project - do it one step at a time.

expressions.meaning_en: the benefits of two different things at the same time
expressions.example: Working from home two days a week gives me the best of both worlds.

expressions.meaning_en: a very bad memory; you forget things easily
expressions.example: I've got a memory like a sieve - I forgot my keys again!

expressions.meaning_ar: انقلب السحر على الساحر / أنت المضحوك عليه
expressions.meaning_en: the person who tried to laugh at others now looks silly
expressions.example: You said I'd never pass, but I got full marks - the joke's on you!
Riding this scooter is easy - there's nothing to it.

expressions.meaning_en: (UK, informal) very disappointed - it does not mean ill
expressions.example: He was as sick as a parrot when his team lost the final.

grammar.title: Comparisons with as ... as
grammar.explanation_ar: نستخدم as + صفة + as للمقارنة والتشبيه: as sick as a parrot. ويوجد في الإنجليزية تشبيهات ثابتة كثيرة مثل: as busy as a bee، as cold as ice. وأحياناً لا يكون المعنى حرفياً.
grammar.explanation_en: We use as + adjective + as to compare: 'as sick as a parrot'. English has many fixed similes like 'as busy as a bee', 'as cold as ice'. The meaning is not always literal.
examples: I was as sick as a parrot about the result.
She is as busy as a bee.
This water is as cold as ice.

questions.question: 'As sick as a parrot' means:
questions.explanation_ar: as sick as a parrot = خائب الأمل جداً، وليس مريضاً.
questions.explanation_en: It means very disappointed, not ill.

questions.question: I keep forgetting my passwords. I've got ___ .
questions.explanation_ar: a memory like a sieve = ذاكرة ضعيفة جداً.
questions.explanation_en: A memory like a sieve = a very bad memory.

questions.question: Her first book ___ as a writer.
questions.explanation_ar: put someone on the map = يجعله مشهوراً.
questions.explanation_en: 'Put someone on the map' = make them famous.

questions.question: A flat in the city with a big garden gives you ___ .
questions.explanation_ar: the best of both worlds = مزايا الأمرين معاً.
questions.explanation_en: You get the benefits of both.

questions.question: Nobody wanted to clean up, so Omar ___ and did it.
choices: was as sick as a parrot
questions.explanation_ar: take one for the team = يضحي من أجل المجموعة.
questions.explanation_en: He did the unpleasant job for the group.

questions.question: 'Making a sandwich? There's nothing to it!' means making a sandwich is:
questions.explanation_ar: there's nothing to it = سهل جداً.

questions.question: Learning to drive is hard. Take it ___ .
questions.explanation_ar: one step at a time = خطوة بخطوة.
questions.explanation_en: Do it slowly, stage by stage.

choices: he took one for the team
questions.explanation_ar: the joke is on him = صار هو المضحوك عليه.
questions.explanation_en: Now he looks silly, not me.

questions.question: Which expression is about being EASY?
questions.explanation_ar: there's nothing to it تعني السهولة.
questions.explanation_en: 'There's nothing to it' means it's easy.

questions.question: Complete: 'I was as ___ as a parrot when the trip was cancelled.'
questions.explanation_ar: التعبير الثابت هو as sick as a parrot.
questions.explanation_en: The fixed expression is 'as sick as a parrot'.
